packageRules.description: Waitarr ships as an image and a package: a runtime dependency change is a fix, so release-please ships it
The compatibility matrix decides which qBittorrent versions are tested; the test image follows it by hand
One Python for the image, the integration job and the publish job: a version or digest update moves all three in one PR. The check matrix (3.12 to 3.15) is not read by Renovate and moves by hand.
pyproject.toml keeps python = "^3.12": the lowest supported version, not the one shipped
